notes:
A fresh look, and a faster start.

- Brand-new splash screen: matches your theme colour, no more white flash, and a much faster cold start.
- New bottom navigation bar, plus a redesigned Settings screen with search.
- Text size: scale the app's text up or down to what feels comfortable.
- Performance mode for low-end devices: smoother scrolling and lighter on memory.
- Listening streaks with a Streak Saver popup that shows your real streak.
- Refreshed launcher icon.
- Updates are now much smaller: only the changed part of the app is downloaded.
